options.name: active
options.description: True if the maintenance is active.

options.name: api_headers
options.description: Headers that are passed to the socketio connection.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The Uptime Kuma password. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_ssl_verify
options.description: true to verify SSL certificates, or false to skip SSL certificate verification, allowing connections to servers with self signed certificates.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the connection, an expected event or a server response.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The Uptime Kuma login token. Only required if no I(api_username) and I(api_password) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Uptime Kuma URL.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The Uptime Kuma username. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_wait_events
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the next event of the same type. There is no way to determine when the last message of a certain type has arrived. Therefore, a timeout is required. If no further message has arrived within this time, it is assumed that it was the last message.

options.name: cron
options.description: The cron schedule of the maintenance.

options.name: dateRange
options.description: The date range of the maintenance.

options.name: daysOfMonth
options.description: The weekdays of the maintenance.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the maintenance.

options.name: durationMinutes
options.description: The duration (in minutes) of the maintenance.

options.name: id
options.description: The id of the maintenance. Only required if no I(title) specified.

options.name: intervalDay
options.description: The interval day of the maintenance.

options.name: monitors
options.description: The monitors of the maintenance.

options.name: status_pages
options.description: The status pages of the maintenance.

options.name: strategy
options.description: The strategy of the maintenance.

options.name: timeRange
options.description: The time range of the maintenance.

options.name: timezoneOption
options.description: The timezone of the maintenance.

options.name: title
options.description: The title of the maintenance. Only required if no I(id) specified.

options.name: weekdays
options.description: The weekdays of the maintenance.
